about_the_game:
Do you think you can complete the roads mysteriously built in outer space? It is time to put your driving skills to the test. Put on the mantle of a Cosmic rider and complete the beautiful roads in outer space.

You have to keep an eye on your Fuel and Oxygen levels, if it reaches zero well than its the game over.

Your Fuel will deplete over time while your Oxygen will deplete if you stays too long in the tunnels and only way to replenish them is to use supply tile, so watch out for those and don't miss them while driving, it might be the very last mistake you could ever make.

Keep an eye on gravity, it will have a direct impact on your jump force, higher the gravity, lower the jump height. There are some levels where gravity is so high you could not be able to jump.

Try to avoid direct head on collision with the obstacles at very high speed, also watch out for different types of special road tile which has various effect both positive and negative.

There are 5 special road tiles,
  • Burning - Destroys your spaceship if you drive on it, best to stay as far away as you can. However, sometimes it would be difficult to do so.

  • Supply - Replenish your fuel and oxygen levels, if you see one, don't miss it, might be your very last mistake.

  • Speed boost - Makes you accelerate rapidly, sometimes it helps, sometimes it makes you overshoot the platform.

  • Sticky - Makes you decelerate rapidly, it maybe good sometimes, other times it makes you undershoot the platform.

  • Slippery - You cannot steer on a slippery tile, you will slide around on them until you land on non slippery tile, be wary.

This is the difficult, precision platformer game, it requires skills, patience and perseverance.

This game is my tribute to the 90s game "Sky roads"

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel core i3 6th gen or AMD A10-8750 or above
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 or AMD RX 570 or above
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any on board sound card

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: intel core i3 9th gen or AMD ryzen 5 2600 or above
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060 or AMD rx 5700 or above
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any on board sound card
